help.title: Instructions
lines: You should see your audio outputs listed in the browser UI. Play some audio to see which output is active (the active level meter will move).
To stream, select the active output, then click the "Start Server" button.
While streaming, the button will change to "Stop Server", and the level meters will be disabled.
To stop streaming, click the "Stop Server" button. It will toggle back to "Start Server".
To quit the app completely, select "Quit" from the system tray menu (the browser UI will deactivate if it's still open).
You can close the browser UI at any time and reopen it by selecting "Show UI" from the system tray menu.
